decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on a proven trommel screen that the firm says has many friends, so it meets the aspiration and gives no trigger for problemistic search, even with less slack after restructuring.
The flail shredder line fits the core mobile-processing portfolio, but with no evidence of results since 2018 and tighter slack it faces some risk of consolidation, not enough to justify dropping it.

With the overlapping green-waste grinder already withdrawn, this grinder line remains the firm's main mobile high-speed grinding offer and serves core customers, so it is more likely to be kept than cut.

The low-visibility stationary electric fine shredder is the most exposed to a search for resources under reduced slack, but it supports the stated push into stationary, resource-saving plants, so management keeps it for now.
The single-shaft pre-shredder line anchors the stationary plant business and shows no clear shortfall against the aspiration, though a tighter focus on core mobile machines puts it at moderate risk.
